messages:
alex: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1848 to update Trident-XL model card — clarifying supported variants, seq limits, shard guidance, and adding SDK v3 snippets for streaming + batched embeddings.

priya: nice. paste proposed limits table?

alex: here:
```
variant | seq_limit | recommended_shards
trident-xl-full | 16384 | ~1 shard per 120 QPS (measured avg prompt=128)
trident-xl-lite-q4 | 16384 | ~1 shard per 95 QPS (~20% perf delta)
```

chen: nit: add footnote 'size for peak QPS' and a KV cache note for contexts >8k tokens.

priya: agree; also we should warn about q4 quality variance for long-context summarization.

alex: added bench link https://bench.redwood/runs/1848-trident and conservative delta 'approx. 18-25% depending on batch size'.

chen: SDK snippets? can you add both JS and Python for v3 patterns?

alex: draft python:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
# batched embeddings (tune batch_size / max_tokens_per_item)
embs = c.embeddings.create(model='trident-xl-full', input=['a','b'], batch_size=8, max_tokens_per_item=256)
```

alex: draft js:
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
// streaming generate (SDK v3 async iterator)
for await (const chunk of client.generate.stream({model:'trident-xl-full', prompt:'Explain recent deployment failures'})) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

priya: tiny tweak: JS option should be batchSize camelCase, add migration blurb 'batch_size -> batchSize'. Also link to migration guide: /docs/migration/sdk-v3.

ci-bot: preview deployed  https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/docs/model-cards/trident-xl (status: success) :white_check_mark:

chen: found broken anchor /docs/ops/sharding -> replaced with /docs/guides/sharding-estimates in PR.

priya: approved from docs. one last ask: add changelog one-liner about q4 perf delta and sharding guidance.

alex: added changelog and merged. changelog: 'Trident-XL: clarified variants and seq limits, added sharding guidance, SDK v3 snippets, and bench links.'

ci-bot: prod sync complete  docs updated at /model-cards/trident-xl :rocket:
